items.mainDefect: The FromContext fallback `return d.New()` drops the original logger's name and contextual attributes, so the resulting logs are attributed to the wrong source.

secondary.defect: ConcreteLogger.New (log.go:219) calls root.New() without returning it when no context is given, which is a bug.

items.mainDefect: The metrics test makes no assertion that grafana_plugin_request_size_bytes stays unrecorded for endpoints where shouldInstrumentRequestSize is false.

secondary.defect: The test only checks the statusOK path, so the error and cancelled status paths in instrumentPluginRequest are never tested.
